card.name: Start of words beginning with K
card.fires_on: The first piece of a word that starts with k, such as kidney, know or kneel, when the word is split into parts. It fires most on the K in Right-to-Know.

modes.label: Right-to-Know
modes.description: The -K piece in the phrase Right-to-Know Act.

modes.label: Kidney split
modes.description: The opening piece of the word kidney, split from the rest of it.

modes.label: Other k words
modes.description: The start of other k words such as kneel or knower.
modes.example: approach the child,<< kne>>el down to the child's level

card.writes: It seems to push toward odd or rare word pieces and away from other K-starting pieces, so the effect is unclear.
